title: The ℚ-vs-ℝ Question: Why Physical Law Requires Only the Rational Numbers
description: Defense of ℚ (rationals) as the physically correct base field over ℝ (reals). 4 sub-claims: Measurement Finitude (Bekenstein/Holevo), Observational Equivalence (epsilon-approximation), Ostrowski Applicability (conditional MF+OE to OTA), Cardinality Non-Constraint (computable reals suffice). 4 falsification conditions (F1-F4). Direct response to Adversary 1 Ostrowski red-team v2 objection.
